excerpts.author: nicoserranop
excerpts.content:
Good news!  🥳  Thanks to <@405860945018093609> we have a functioning web version of the frontend in IPFS: https://ceremony-ipfs.efprivacyscaling.org/ . It shows people the IPFS content hash but it is only accesible via a custom headers IPFS gateway. We would have a tutorial in the repo of how to set up the gateway (just edit the conf file using `ipfs config edit`).

The actual IPFS version is a bit outdated. We will need to rebuild it using the current state of the main branch
